units.source_text: 晚春的下午，明媚的气氛极度的沉闷，这样的事是很容易发生的。

en.t: On a late spring afternoon, when the bright atmosphere feels oppressively heavy, such things can easily happen.

units.source_text: 也就是说，我变成了双重结构，

en.t: In other words, I had become a double structure,

units.source_text: 我的分身预先模仿了我的行为，

en.t: and my other self had imitated my actions in advance,

units.source_text: 当我一旦坚决实行的时候，就会让我清清楚楚地看到平素看不见的我自身的形象。

en.t: so that once I carried them out with resolve, it would make me see clearly the image of myself that I could not ordinarily see.
